item.title: Forging Joint Force Leaders to Win: Air Force Global College Connects 1972 Airpower to Today’s Fight
item.description: Air University’s Air Force Global College is using lessons from the 1972 Easter Offensive to sharpen how today’s leaders think about joint warfighting. In a recent distance learning seminar, faculty and students examined how integrated airpower — operating at the tactical, operational and strategic levels simultaneously — helped blunt a large-scale conventional invasion. item.title: CAL MED strengthens medical readiness at the Presidio of Monterey
item.description: PRESIDIO OF MONTEREY, Calif. — The Presidio of Monterey (POM) is home to some of the Department of War’s most intellectually demanding missions. item.title: Virginia Air National Guard Airman commissions following direct appointment
item.description: After years of pursuing her commission through changing policy and continued enlisted service, U.S. Air Force Airman 1st Class Alexandria Thompson, 192nd Aircraft Maintenance Squadron, was commissioned as a second lieutenant during a commissioning ceremony Feb. 21, 2026, at Joint Base Langley-Eustis in Hampton, Virginia.

item.title: Virtual sick call appointments expand access and convenience for service members
item.description: Active-duty service members across the Defense Health Network Indo Pacific (DHN IP) now have expanded access to virtual sick call appointments beyond regular sick call hours, offering a faster and more convenient way to receive care while reducing the spread of infectious illnesses. The growing use of virtual care reflects the Military Health System’s commitment to improving access, readiness, and patient experience.
